name: Ryan Hall
address: 28 Elmwood Avenue, Belfast BT9 6AY, United Kingdom
about:
Welcome to Ryan Hall, your new home in the heart of Belfast. This new luxury student accommodation has been designed to offer fantastic value and flexible tenancy options, all within the vibrant Queen's Quarter. 
Our prime location is a stone's throw from the main Queen's University Belfast campus, making us the perfect choice for Queen's students. Getting to class is simple, with the university’s main buildings and the Students’ Union just across the street. The area is also well connected by public transport, making it easy to explore the city. 
Our self-contained studio apartments offer a premium student living experience that provides residents with the privacy that they desire. Featuring modern furnishings and a comfortable sleeping area, you’ll rest easy in the knowledge that everything you need is right where you want it to be. 
Being able to focus on your studies rather than stressing about upcoming bills can be a real bonus, which is why all of your utility bills are included in the rental price. 
At Ryan Hall, we also offer an impressive range of amenities designed to support your academic and social life. As part of the Queens Chaplaincy, students will have access to the onsite café, reading room and amazing social spaces including a tranquil courtyard and communal lounge that are all accessible during business hours. This allows you to meet friends and family for a coffee and a cake whenever you like. 
We also make everyday tasks a breeze with our convenient onsite laundry room, ensuring your clothes always look and smell their best. 
Additionally, you can enjoy the benefits of a range of library resources and study spaces that allow you to work from the comfort of your own home. Meanwhile, a quick and reliable broadband network ensures you’ll stay connected to Wi-Fi throughout the building. 
We're proud to offer full disabled access to Ryan Hall, meaning that everyone can feel a part of their student community during their time with us. 
To further enhance your experience, our dedicated onsite management team is available to assist you with any questions or concerns. We also have 24/7 surveillance and a secure entry system, providing you with extra peace of mind. 
We also host regular social events, helping you build a strong sense of community and make new friends from day one. At Ryan Hall, we're committed to making your student experience as relaxing and successful as possible. 
We also haven't forgotten about students at Ulster University; the nearby bus line offers a quick and direct route across the city that takes you to within walking distance of the main campus. 
This brand new development will ensure you’re at the heart of Belfast’s thriving young population and allow you to connect with your fellow residents in an enjoyable and pressure free environment.
